purpose: Latest owner instruction supersedes organic/variable width studies: one rectangular zigzag from portal to throne, constant about five tower footprints wide, no branches; retain B gameplay-strip material style.
guide_note: Original code-native geometric input only, rendered by macOS Quick Look; final illustration is created by built-in ImageGen. Guide centerline coordinates specify illustrative topology and five-unit width, not accepted production route length or endpoint distance.
prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Asset type: ONE original game-map reference, not a runtime asset.
Input image 1 is the EXACT GEOMETRY GUIDE to preserve. Image 2 is the chosen original B CARTOON 2D style reference: match the gray ROAD AND GRASS IN ITS BOTTOM GAMEPLAY STRIP. Image 3 supplies only the established red portal and cyan soul objective identity.
Primary request: render the guide as a handsome hand-drawn cartoon stone-paved road in green meadow. The owner's revised requirement is a RECTANGULAR ZIGZAG, with straight runs, ninety-degree ground-plane corners, and UNIFORM WIDTH OF ABOUT FIVE TOWER GROUND FOOTPRINTS. This replaces earlier curving and variable 8/3 width experiments.
GEOMETRY IS LOCKED TO IMAGE 1. Keep the gray mask silhouette, all straight edges, ALL FOUR square bends, relative spacing of the three long parallel runs, their two short end connectors, and the orthographic isometric ground projection. There is exactly ONE continuous unbranched road with exactly TWO endpoints. Start at the red disk near the top; follow the existing gray mask through every rectangular bend to the cyan disk near the bottom. Each bend is a ninety-degree turn in the ground plane, seen as a diamond-grid angle in isometric projection. No rounding into S-curves. Do not reinterpret it into a Y, T, loop, arena or intersection. No additional gray paving outside this ONE guide mask, no road forks, no shortcuts between runs, no disconnected strip, no road outside the frame, no spur beyond either endpoint.
Uniform breadth is FIVE complete tower footprints everywhere along the straight runs and around square corners, with no necks, circular plazas, bulges or variable-width regions. The five small pale guide squares are ONE exact transverse row of tower footprints across the top run. Replace each guide square with one lightly translucent SMALL red-roof Rapid tower, FIVE TOTAL, at exactly that footprint scale. Keep their bases aligned with those squares from one road edge to the other, so it is clear how much width there is. This is a scale-test overlay, not a permanent full-block defense. No other towers, no towers on grass, no scaling cheats. The rest of the paving remains empty.
Replace the red disk at its existing location by the established intact dark-slate portal ring with a red vortex; place its feet within the road. Replace the cyan disk at its existing location by the established cyan soul sphere under a clear ice-blue dome on a slate bowl base. Both landmarks have a ground footprint about three tower cells across and fit WITHIN the same five-cell road, no extra round plaza. Remove all guide disks and pale guide tiles once replaced.
TERRAIN STYLE: precisely B's lower gameplay-strip material language: substantial rectangular gray flagstones in staggered isometric courses, softly beveled chipped edges, weeds growing in joints, subtle warm gray/olive variation. Around the road, warm yellow-green short pointed turf with earthy undergrowth, little daisies, small bushes and sparse conifers/pale rocks on the green only. Preserve readable large illustrated shapes, clean expressive cartoon contour lines, restrained soft shading and consistent upper-left light. Smooth directly drawn 2D sprite-art finish, not a 3D clay render, pixel art or a realistic photograph. Small irregular vegetation at the border can soften stone wear but must not change the square overall corners or usable uniform breadth.
Composition: same full-route framing and same camera as guide, enough meadow border to see every road edge and both endpoints without cropping. Keep all content on one flat ground plane. No text, no heading, no inset panels, no HUD, no grid overlay, no route arrows, no skeleton wave covering the road. Original project artwork only.
refinement_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit this image with ONE tiny targeted change. The transverse test row on the upper straight road currently contains FOUR red-roof Rapid towers. It must contain exactly FIVE, because the road is five tower footprints wide.
Replace that row with exactly FIVE complete, equally small, identical Rapid towers side by side ACROSS the road from one edge to the other, all five full ground bases on the paving, at a common fixed scale and no roof/foot cut-offs. They may be lightly translucent to show this is a measurement overlay. Five separate red roofs and five separate square foundations must be visible and countable. Add the fifth at the open right-hand end of the existing row; redistribute the row only within the existing gray width if needed.
LOCK EVERYTHING ELSE. Preserve the entire road outline and its constant width, its single continuous branch-free topology, all FOUR square ground-plane turns, straight parallel runs, exact grass gaps, framing, paved stone style, grass and props, portal and soul objective position/size/camera. Do not add road, branch, spur, junction, widening, narrowing, inset, text, arrows or other towers. Do not change any other part of the image.
